text:
matt: Quick ping 3050 lunch sprint? 10 min hill repeats at the park near the loading dock. low fuss, quick return.
rachel: I'm tempted. how steep is the hill? will I die? 
omar: It's the gentle 'I-will-sweat-but-not-cry' incline. 4 x 90s hard, walk down recovery. scalable.
sasha: Can I sub with fast walk? got a tight calf this week.
matt: Absolutely. Options: sprint, tempo, or power-walk. Everyone logs what they do.
fit-bot: Reminder: meet at loading-dock entrance at 12:35. Weather check 12:15. Safety note: bring water & shoes with tread.
rachel: I'll bring a small cone for the turnaround marker and a spare band for assisted calf stretches.
omar: Who's on timekeeping? I'll time with my watch. Also can someone volunteer to be unofficial photo ninja? no faces unless ok.
sasha: I can be ninja but promise not to post. upbeat cheering only.
matt: Plan: 12:35 quick warmup (4m), 12:40 - hill repeats (4 rounds), 12:55 - 3-min mobility cooldown, 13:00 back to desks.
rachel: Sign me up. Also winner gets a packet of energy chew samples from my bag. low-stakes prize.
omar: Count me in. will scale if needed.
fit-bot: I'll DM the short waiver link for participants. See y'all at 12:35! :running_shirt_with_sash:
